description: Copies the registration and thank-you pages of one webinar onto another, which is how you reuse a page design after a move. Take it when two webinars should look the same: "Take the pages from the spring webinar for the new one." It needs the session, the webinar the pages come from, the webinar they go to, and a clear yes from you. The pages already on the target are replaced by the copied ones and the copy cannot be undone, while the source stays as it is. Say which two webinars are involved and that the target's pages are overwritten before anything happens. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: copy pages, reuse my design, same page again, pages from other webinar, duplicate page

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that the target's pages may be replaced.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

source_id.description: The webinar whose pages are copied, from wi_list_webinars.

target_id.description: The webinar whose pages are replaced, from wi_list_webinars.

name: wi_copy_webinar_pages
title: Copy the pages of one webinar onto another
